rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, which aligns with policy. However, it did not complete any of the user’s requests (address update, watch modification, air purifier exchange). After authentication, the agent could have used read-only tools to inspect the three listed orders, identify the one with two watches, and the one with sneakers/air purifier, and locate the New York address from another order. It could then have presented specific proposed changes and sought explicit confirmation, as required. Instead, it repeatedly refused to proceed without the user supplying an order number or details, despite having enough access to investigate and propose candidates. Since no requested changes were performed or confirmed, the conversation does not meet the pass bar of completing the user’s request in line with policy.
